name: Georgia

response.rule_text: Agency must respond within a reasonable time not to exceed three business days; if records cannot be produced in that time it must give a description and timeline, O.C.G.A. § 50-18-71(b)(1)(A).

fees.labor_rule: Reasonable charge for search, retrieval, redaction and production not exceeding the prorated hourly salary of the lowest-paid full-time employee able to do the task, no charge for the first quarter hour, O.C.G.A. § 50-18-71(d).
fees.copy_rule: Reasonable copying cost; Act sets parameters for reasonableness.
fees.waiver_rule: Act neither requires nor prohibits fee waivers.

residency.rule_text: Identity of the requester is irrelevant; the right is a public right of the People as a whole (Deal v. Coleman).

appeal.body: Superior court; AG may enforce; AG mediation program
appeal.rule_text: The Act provides no administrative appeal; enforcement is by civil action, and the AG may bring actions and run an Open Government Mediation Program, O.C.G.A. § 50-18-73. No specific limitations period.

notes: Governor's office: RCFP says some governors take position they're not subject but comply; legislature coverage not confirmed. Universities: public university records held public in case law. Fee subsection cite § 50-18-71(c) taken from RCFP fee discussion; confirm exact paragraph against statute.
